rounds.text: Despite headline growth figures, the underlying margin and cash-flow mechanics reveal deep inconsistencies. Operating margins have collapsed by 12 percentage points over three years down to 11% in Mar 2026, and the yearly operating-margin trend is explicitly rated as inconsistent [E23, E25]. This margin degradation coincides with a sharp deterioration in working capital efficiency, as working capital days have ballooned from 56.3 days to 97.0 days [E56]. Furthermore, reported earnings quality is heavily compromised by a massive other income component of Rs 13.1 Cr [E54], masking core operational volatility. Shareholder returns are completely absent through dividends, matching a history of capital decay where 3-year compounded profit growth sits at -15% alongside an identical -15% drop in share price [E4, E14, E17]. Additionally, promoter holdings have drifted downward over the last 3 years by 5.43% [E55], while the business exhibits extreme historical vulnerability with a peak-to-trough drawdown of -83.8% and an annualized volatility of 127.5% [E45, E46]. Conceded: [E15].

While the bear highlights a drop in historical operating margin [E23], it ignores that quarterly operating margin rebounded sharply to 21% in March 2026, marking a significant six percentage point expansion over the year-ago quarter [E24]. On the issue of earnings quality, the business generated robust operating cash flow of Rs 30 Cr and free cash flow of Rs 24 Cr in March 2026 [E28, E29], with a cash conversion ratio of 1.25x proving that profits are fully backed by actual cash [E27]. Conceded: [E54], [E56]. Furthermore, the multi-year profit slowdown noted by the bear [E14] has decisively flipped, evidenced by trailing twelve-month profit surging 169% and sales growing 36% [E11, E15], backed by a rules-based screen score of 87 out of 100 [E57]. The minor reduction in promoter holding [E34] leaves a commanding 69.65% stake in insider hands, and the conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.26x [E31] alongside a 28.2% ROCE [E6] shows a highly efficient, fundamentally sound operation trading at an unjustified P/E of just 6.92x [E1].

Conceded: [E24]. While the quarterly margin bounced, the structural decay is real given that operating margin sits at 11% in Mar 2026 against 23% three years earlier, reflecting a steep twelve percentage point compression [E23], alongside an inconsistent yearly and quarterly margin trend [E25, E26]. The bull points to cash flow [E28, E29], but earnings quality is visibly impaired because reported earnings include a non-operating component of Rs 13.1 Cr in other income [E54]. Furthermore, the massive trailing profit surge [E15] masks severe underlying lumpiness and historical volatility, including a 3-year compounded profit contraction of -15% [E14] and decelerating earnings growth flagged by screens [E62]. The bull dismisses insider selling, but promoter holding has actually dropped over the last three years by -5.43% [E55]. Finally, this volatile cash generator comes with extreme historical risk, evidenced by an annualised volatility of 127.5% and a catastrophic peak-to-trough drawdown of -83.8% [E45, E46].
